scenes.label: Natural hero portrait
scenes.prompt: a relaxed waist-up portrait outdoors in open shade, approachable expression, simple well-fitted casual clothing, uncluttered real-world background

scenes.label: Smart-casual portrait
scenes.prompt: a believable three-quarter or full-body smart-casual portrait near a modern restaurant or architectural entrance, confident relaxed posture, natural clothing folds

scenes.label: Active hobby moment
scenes.prompt: a genuine lifestyle action photo during an outdoor hobby, caught mid-motion rather than posing, believable equipment, correct hands and body mechanics

scenes.label: Travel story
scenes.prompt: a spontaneous travel photograph at a visually interesting destination, interacting naturally with the setting, layered depth, no tourist-advertisement staging

scenes.label: Pet or relaxed lifestyle
scenes.prompt: a warm candid lifestyle moment with a pet in a comfortable home or neighborhood setting, affectionate natural interaction, anatomically correct hands and animal

scenes.label: Social night out
scenes.prompt: a lively but believable evening social photo at a stylish lounge or restaurant, the subject clearly identifiable among distinct friends, natural expressions and mixed warm light

scenes.label: Coffee-shop candid
scenes.prompt: a quiet candid moment at an independent coffee shop, looking away while reading or setting down a drink, unstaged posture, believable window light

scenes.label: Full-body style photo
scenes.prompt: a clean full-body street-style photograph, understated coordinated outfit, relaxed stance, realistic proportions and shoes, subtle urban background

scenes.label: Food and social moment
scenes.prompt: a natural social photograph at a local restaurant or outdoor market, engaged with the experience rather than presenting food to the camera, authentic ambient details

scenes.label: Close-up editorial portrait
scenes.prompt: a close natural portrait with calm direct eye contact, authentic pores and fine facial texture, simple background, flattering but plausible light

scenes.prompt: a coherent real-world lifestyle photograph matching the user's creative brief
